Subject: Intro + proposed group demo: Redwood inference walkthrough

Hi Sara / EdgeCloud team,

Thanks again for the quick chats earlier. A few customers expressed interest in seeing a short, focused walkthrough of Redwood’s inference platform together — it saves repeated coverage of the same material and surfaces integration questions up front. Would Olive Analytics and EdgeCloud be open to a 45-min shared demo where we cover:

- Quick intro & objectives (5m)
- Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployment comparison (10m)
- Live run: latency/cost levers and a short prompt-to-response demo (15m)
- Integration / breakout: partner and engineering Q&A (15m)

Proposed slot: Tue, 22 Jun, 2027 — 9:00 AM PT (45 mins). If that doesn't work I can propose alternate windows.

Marissa / Ben / Lauren — can you join? Ben, can you drive the demo; Lauren, please be on standby for the deep technical Q&A. I’ll send a calendar invite once time is confirmed.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
